design: For each campus-system pair, the top-decile lift of the ranking on each evaluable peer campus, read through the model that excluded the target and the peer, with a building-level bootstrap variance of its logarithm; a random-effects model on the log lifts (REML); the predictive probability P that the true lift on a new campus is at least 2; accepted when P >= p0. Compared with the evidence gating over the 141 pairs and the 16 systems of the pooled map, and checked on the held-out campus.

definitions.peer_lift: top-decile lift of f^(-{c,d}) on the units of system k on peer campus d, for peers with >= 10 high-burden quarters and >= 100 units of the system
definitions.variance: variance of the log lift over 1000 replicates resampling with replacement the buildings that hold system k on campus d; replicate counts carry a continuity correction of 0.5
definitions.random_effects: log L_d ~ N(theta_d, v_d), theta_d ~ N(mu, tau^2); tau^2 by REML, mu by inverse-variance weights 1/(v_d + tau^2)
definitions.P: P(theta_new >= log 2), theta_new ~ mu_hat + sqrt(tau^2 + SE(mu_hat)^2) * t_(k-2) for k >= 3; standard normal in place of t for k = 2; no estimate for k < 2
definitions.accepted: P >= p0; not accepted when fewer than two peers are evaluable
definitions.principal_level: p0 = 0.8, fixed as a convention before agreement with the gating was computed; 0.5 and 0.9 reported as sensitivity
definitions.heldout: top-decile lift of f^(-c) on system k in campus c, for the 95 pairs evaluable there (>= 10 high-burden quarters, >= 100 units)
definitions.exchangeability: the rule treats the target campus as exchangeable with its peers: its true log lift is a draw from the same normal distribution

exclusion_check.statement: every row of the corpus for target c is a peer row scored by a model whose held-out set contains c and that peer

estimator_check.data: BCG vaccine trials, 13 log risk ratios (Colditz et al. 1994)

bootstrap.unit: buildings holding the system on the campus
bootstrap.seeds: one seed per (corpus, campus, system), drawn in a fixed order from numpy.random.default_rng(RANDOM_SEED)

rule_variants.reml_p0.8: principal: REML, p0 = 0.8, normal form at two peers
rule_variants.dl_p0.8: sensitivity: DerSimonian-Laird estimate of tau^2, p0 = 0.8
rule_variants.reml_p0.8_min3peers: sensitivity added after the principal results were seen: as the principal rule, but no verdict for pairs with two evaluable peers
